createOrReplace.excerpt: International students An equivalent of a Dutch pre-university education (VWO) diploma with a comparable level of Mathematics. If you do not have this level, the equivalent of Dutch VWO Mathematics B can be acquired through: Having obtained at least 60% for the Online Mathematics Placement Test (OMPT-D), or, have obtained an International Baccalaureate™ Diploma (IB DP) taught in English or with English A HL. IELTS - Academic modules only, on paper or on computer. Minimum score of 6.0 overall and 6.0 for each separate component. TOEFL Internet Based. Minimum score of 4.5 overall, with at least 4.5 for each separate component score (or 80 overall and 20 for each separate component if taken before 21 January 2026).
